description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SharePoint Online Developer based in the United States. 

 We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Online Developer to contribute to the modernization of a claims processing system for a Florida state agency. In this role, you will lead the document management component of a large-scale digital transformation initiative, replacing legacy systems with modern Microsoft technologies. You will design and configure SharePoint Online solutions and integrate them with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, and Azure Government. Your work will help establish secure, scalable, and compliant document management processes while improving information accessibility and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with technical leads, developers, migration specialists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions. This fully remote contract opportunity offers the chance to contribute to a significant government technology project with an expected implementation period of approximately two years.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Design, configure, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, document libraries, metadata structures, content types, and permission models to support claims document management.



 
 Develop automated workflows using Power Automate to streamline document-related business processes.



 
 Integrate SharePoint Online with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, and related enterprise platforms to ensure seamless document management and accessibility.



 
 Configure enterprise search capabilities, document versioning, and retention policies in accordance with records management, security, and compliance requirements.



 
 Support the migration of legacy documents and workflows to SharePoint Online, collaborating with data migration teams on document linking, indexing, validation, and quality assurance.



 
 Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues involving user access, permissions, workflow automation, metadata, and system integrations.



 
 Document SharePoint configurations, technical processes, and solution designs to ensure maintainability and effective knowledge transfer.



 
 Collaborate with technical leads, Power Platform developers, migration specialists, and business stakeholders to develop secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.



 
 Ensure document management solutions align with project objectives, technical standards, and applicable government or regulatory requirements.



 
 Contribute to the continuous improvement and optimization of the overall document management architecture.




 Requirements:


 
 At least five (5) years of professional experience in SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 development.



 
 Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, SharePoint document libraries, metadata management, and content types.



 
 Demonstrated experience configuring enterprise search, document versioning, and retention policies.



 
 Experience integrating SharePoint Online with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, or comparable CRM and enterprise business platforms.



 
 Solid understanding of SharePoint Online architecture, document management practices, permissions, and workflow automation.



 
 Experience supporting document migration, information architecture modernization, or legacy workflow replacement is highly desirable.



 
 Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and develop secure, maintainable solutions.



 
 Strong understanding of document governance, records management, and compliance-driven processes.



 
 Experience working in insurance, legal, claims processing, or other regulated environments is preferred.



 
 Previous experience supporting government projects or organizations operating under regulatory requirements is an advantage.



 
 Microsoft 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.



 
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.



 
 Strong communication and collaboration abilities, with the capacity to work effectively alongside technical teams and business stakeholders.



 
 Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities within a distributed project team.



 
 Must be based in the United States and available for contract employment.



 
 Applications must be submitted directly by candidates; third-party vendors and intermediaries are not accepted.




 Benefits:


 
 Competitive compensation ranging from $70 to $80 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



 
 Flexible engagement options, with both 1099 independent contractor and W-2 employment arrangements available.



 
 Fully remote work arrangement within the United States.



 
 Full-time contract opportunity.



 
 Expected contract duration of approximately two years, with potential for extension.



 
 Opportunity to contribute to a major government digital transformation and claims processing modernization project.



 
 Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Azure Government.



 
 Collaboration with experienced technical professionals and multidisciplinary project teams.



 
 Opportunity to work on enterprise-level document management, automation, and systems integration initiatives.
